items.question: In the UAE federal government, what is the maximum total number of days per year an employee may work remotely from within the country under the remote work system?
items.gold: The duration of remote work from within the country must not exceed 30 days per year, consecutive or non-consecutive.
items.fact: Federal remote work within the country capped at 30 days yearly

items.question: In the UAE federal government remote work system, can an employee combine a remote work period from within the country with annual leave or unpaid leave?
items.gold: No, it is not permitted to combine remote work with annual leave or unpaid leave.
items.fact: Remote work cannot be combined with annual or unpaid leave
